meta.title: NapKey — Claude Code billed in Vietnamese dong
meta.description: Top up from 10,000 d and run Claude Code or your Anthropic/OpenAI SDK through NapKey. No monthly plan, billed by actual token usage.
meta.ogAlt: NapKey — prepaid wallet API gateway for Claude

hero.note: No monthly plan. No maintenance fee. Every request is recorded with its model, token usage, and actual cost.
hero.terminalComment: Keep Claude Code. Change only the gateway.
hero.terminalSubtitle: Keep the workflow, change the gateway

value.title: We handle the hard part, you just call the API

streaming.title: Streams that survive long runs
streaming.body: The proxy layer holds SSE connections through multi-minute sessions. No re-buffering, no cutting mid-stream.

failover.title: Pooled accounts with failover
failover.body: Requests round-robin across multiple upstream accounts. When one fails, traffic moves on and you never see it.

oneKey.title: One key, every model
oneKey.body: Opus, Sonnet and Haiku share a single key. Switch models with one field in the body, not a new credential.

trustSection.title: Evidence, not a trust badge
trustSection.subtitle: The useful question is not whether a gateway says it is secure. It is whether you can inspect health, correlate a request, audit its charge, and understand where data goes.
trustSection.manifest: Every charge should trace back to one request. Every limitation should be written down before you top up.
trustSection.manifestBody: NapKey exposes the mechanics developers can verify: a public liveness probe, request IDs, per-call usage records, explicit upstream boundaries, and visible key-revocation propagation state.

requestId.title: Request correlation
requestId.body: Billable calls return an x-request-id that matches the request ledger.

ledger.title: Auditable charges
ledger.body: Model, input, output, cache tokens, latency and cost remain visible per request.

keys.title: Controlled credentials
keys.body: Management APIs return masked identifiers. Disable and revoke actions expose their synchronization state instead of pretending propagation cannot fail.

prompts.title: Bounded content retention
prompts.body: Prompt payloads are excluded from request debug logs; Responses API storage is separately disclosed with its 30-day cleanup policy.

compatibilitySection.title: Keep your client. Keep your exit.
compatibilitySection.subtitle: NapKey competes by reducing migration cost, not by inventing a proprietary SDK. Use established Anthropic and OpenAI request shapes, inspect the active catalog, and move away by restoring your endpoint.
compatibilitySection.contract: Your integration should outlive your gateway vendor.
compatibilitySection.body: The Compatibility Center records what is accepted natively, what NapKey translates, and where behavior can still differ from an upstream provider.

anthropic.title: Anthropic Messages
anthropic.body: Messages, streaming, tool use and token counting through familiar request shapes.

openai.title: OpenAI Chat
openai.body: Chat Completions requests translated onto the same NapKey data plane.

responses.title: Responses API
responses.body: Responses-style calls supported with explicitly documented storage boundaries.

compatibilityPage.title: A gateway you can adopt without marrying
compatibilityPage.intro: A versionable map of NapKey's public model catalog, protocol surface and migration paths. It separates supported request shapes from translated behavior so you can judge portability before routing production traffic.

catalog.title: What the data plane advertises now
catalog.scope: This list comes from the public models endpoint when reachable. It describes accepted model identifiers, not a guarantee that every upstream account has capacity at this moment.

matrix.title: Know what is native, translated, or bounded
matrix.scope: Supported means NapKey accepts the request surface. Translation may introduce behavioral differences; upstream-specific beta fields are not implied unless listed here.
matrix.caption: NapKey protocol and feature compatibility

chat.name: Chat Completions
chat.note: OpenAI-shaped chat requests are translated onto the gateway data plane.

responses.name: Responses API
responses.note: Supported at /v1/responses; stored-response retention is disclosed in the data policy.

streaming.name: SSE streaming
streaming.note: Streaming is proxied; exact event details follow the selected protocol surface.

tools.name: Tool use
tools.note: Tool definitions and results cross the translation boundary when using OpenAI shapes.

vision.name: Vision input
vision.note: Accepted media still depends on the selected model and upstream capability.

thinking.name: Thinking variants
thinking.note: Use an advertised -thinking identifier; reasoning behavior remains model-dependent.

migration.title: The smallest reversible change
migration.scope: Keep provider SDKs and application code where possible. Put endpoint and credentials in environment configuration so rollback remains a configuration change.

claudeCode.title: Claude Code
claudeCode.body: Point Claude Code at NapKey and use your NapKey credential. Remove these overrides to return to the original provider.

anthropic.title: Anthropic SDK
anthropic.body: Keep the official SDK and request schema. Change the base URL and credential only.

openai.title: OpenAI SDK
openai.body: Keep Chat Completions or Responses-shaped calls while NapKey translates them onto its data plane.

contract.title: Compatibility is not identical upstream behavior
contract.body: NapKey does not promise byte-for-byte parity with every SDK release, beta header or provider-specific extension. The public catalog can change as upstream models change, and successful model listing does not guarantee live upstream capacity. Test the exact features your application relies on before switching production traffic.

trustPage.title: What NapKey can prove — and what it cannot
trustPage.intro: A technical account of identity, key handling, request metadata, billing and the upstream boundary. Written to be checked, not skimmed.

identity.title: Independent service
identity.body: NapKey is an independent API gateway and prepaid billing service. Requests are processed through third-party infrastructure, including AWS-operated services; no provider endorsement is implied.

keyHandling.title: API key handling
keyHandling.body: A new key is shown once in the console and the control plane stores its hash. The data plane currently retains the bearer credential in restricted server configuration because it must authenticate calls; management responses expose only a masked identifier. Revocation is pushed to the data plane and may enter a visible retry state if propagation fails, so treat an exposed key as usable until deletion is synchronized.

requestData.title: Request records
requestData.body: The customer ledger stores request ID, model, token categories, cost, status and latency. Full prompts are not written to production request debug logs. Requests still pass through NapKey and the configured upstream provider. Responses API files become eligible for deletion after 30 days; an hourly cleanup job and startup sweep remove expired files.

billing.title: Billing evidence
billing.body: A billable response carries x-request-id. The same ID is used for hold settlement and the usage ledger, so one charge can be reconciled to one call. Historical usage is not repriced after a rate change.

upstream.title: Upstream boundary
upstream.body: Model output depends on upstream accounts and services outside NapKey's direct control. Pooling and failover reduce individual account failures but do not create a guarantee of uninterrupted availability.

limits.title: Current limits
limits.body: NapKey does not currently offer a formal SLA, tax invoices or bank withdrawals of wallet balance. Public status reports current reachability, not historical uptime guarantees.

statusPage.title: NapKey service readiness, checked now
statusPage.intro: The status page checks the gateway, billing ledger, and usage reporting path together. It reports current service readiness, not a historical SLA guarantee.

stateBodies.operational: Essential components are responding within operating thresholds.
stateBodies.degraded: The service is available, but capacity, error rate, or the usage queue crossed a warning threshold.
stateBodies.outage: At least one essential dependency is unavailable. New requests may fail.

statusPage.scope: Account counts, quotas, and internal details remain private. Status is calculated from live operational signals.

privacyPage.title: What data moves through NapKey
privacyPage.intro: A plain-language description of data required to operate accounts, proxy requests and reconcile prepaid usage.

account.title: Account data
account.body: NapKey stores your email address, password hash, verification state and account timestamps to operate authentication and account recovery.

prompts.title: Prompts and responses
prompts.body: Prompt and response content passes through the gateway and configured upstream provider. Full prompt payloads are excluded from production request debug logs. Responses API stored-response files contain input, instructions and output; they become eligible for deletion after 30 days and are removed by hourly and startup cleanup. Do not send secrets or regulated data unless your own risk assessment permits it.

usage.title: Usage metadata
usage.body: NapKey retains request ID, API key identifier, model, token counts, cost, latency, status and time for billing, support and reconciliation.

payments.title: Payment records
payments.body: Top-up orders and bank webhook events retain transaction references, amounts, processing status and reconciliation metadata. Payment payloads are restricted to operational access.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: The console uses secure session and CSRF cookies for sign-in and request protection. NapKey does not add advertising pixels or third-party behavioral analytics.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.body: You can revoke API keys at any time and change your account password. Contact support before sharing sensitive diagnostic material; always redact API keys and credentials.

termsPage.title: Terms for using NapKey
termsPage.intro: The operational conditions you should understand before funding a wallet or routing production traffic.

service.title: Service
service.body: NapKey provides an independent compatibility gateway and prepaid usage ledger. Access depends on NapKey infrastructure and third-party upstream services.

balance.title: Wallet balance
balance.body: Wallet funds are prepaid service credit, do not expire under the current policy and cannot be withdrawn to a bank account. Top up only an amount you expect to use.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: Do not use NapKey to violate law, probe or disrupt systems, bypass provider restrictions, distribute malware, or expose credentials belonging to another person.

availability.title: Availability
availability.body: The service is provided without a formal uptime SLA at this stage. Maintenance, upstream changes, quota exhaustion and account availability may interrupt requests.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.body: Rates may change with exchange rates and upstream pricing. New rates apply from their effective time; usage already recorded keeps its original settled cost.

independence.title: Brand independence
independence.body: NapKey operates independently from third-party model and infrastructure providers, including AWS-operated services. Claude and related names belong to their respective owners.

ecosystem.title: Your coding tools in. The right Claude model out.
ecosystem.subtitle: NapKey keeps the client you already use, routes Anthropic-compatible requests through one prepaid key, and records every charge in Vietnamese dong.
ecosystem.hubBody: One endpoint for authentication, routing, failover and per-request billing.
ecosystem.catalogNote: Model availability follows the live gateway catalog and upstream account capacity.

integrate.title: Change the endpoint in two lines
integrate.subtitle: NapKey speaks both the Anthropic Messages API and OpenAI Chat Completions. Your existing client works as-is.

pricing.title: One credit rate across every model
pricing.subtitle: No manual input, output, or cache-token conversion. NapKey records upstream-reported credits and deducts the wallet at a fixed 75 VND per credit.

offer.title: 100% first-top-up bonus, capped at 1,000 credits
offer.body: Receive a 100% first-top-up bonus, capped at 1,000 promotional credits valid for 30 days. Purchased credits never expire.

pricing.packageNote: The same 75 VND/credit rate, with no package lock-in or long-term commitment.
pricing.measurement: Credits come from actual usage reported by the upstream service. The dashboard records each request, model, reference token counts, credits, and settled VND for reconciliation.
pricing.footnote: NapKey wallet credits do not expire under the current policy. Settled usage always retains the rate effective when it was recorded.

launchOffer.title: One API key. More AI tools. Pay in VND.
launchOffer.body: Connect Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, the Anthropic SDK, or the OpenAI SDK. No monthly fee — pay only for what you use.
launchOffer.terms: Bonus capped at 1,000 credits and expires after 30 days. Purchased credits never expire.

topup.title: Top up the wallet
topup.body: Bank transfer, or scan a VietQR code with the amount and reference already filled in. Transfers reconcile automatically.

use.title: Call the API
use.body: Each request deducts the tokens it actually used at the model's rate. No rounding up, no per-request minimum.

track.title: Audit every line
track.body: Each request writes one usage row: model, input tokens, output tokens, cost. Reconcilable down to a single call.

refund.a: No. Balance can only be spent on API calls; it is not refundable to a bank account. Please weigh that before topping up.

expiry.a: It does not. No maintenance fee and no inactivity fee.

minimum.a: 10,000 d. You can increase the amount in 1,000 d steps.

invoice.a: Not at this stage. If you need a VAT invoice, please get in touch before topping up.

cta.title: Want to try it?
cta.body: Put in 10,000 d, grab a key, change the endpoint. If it is not for you, that is all you spent.

footer.tagline: A prepaid wallet API gateway for Claude, billed in VND.
footer.disclaimer: NapKey is an independent service and is not an Anthropic product. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic PBC.
